text_block_list.text: One day after training, as I'm walking Biwa Hayahide to her dorm just before curfew…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Hayahide! It's rare to see you out and about at this late hour.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, I was training heavily today, and—ah, are you speaking in your capacity as dorm leader? I'm sorry to come back so late.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, not at all! I adore the chance to welcome back my ponies after a hard day's work, no matter the time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: By the by, did you happen to see Sweep and Marvelous on your way here?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: They're not answering their phones. And as they are among our younger residents, I can't help but feel a bit… trepidatious.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: With good reason—we should search for them immediately. I'll help, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My eternal gratitude to you both!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Might I suggest we split our efforts? You two work together in search of one, and I shall look for the other.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Right. Do you have any information on where they might be?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Only that Marvelous went off on a so-called "marvelous search," and Sweep set out to look for magic ingredients.
choice_data_list: Sweep sounds easier to pin down.
Marvelous could be anywhere, so let's try to find her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, there are a limited number of items that might be considered magic ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's take advantage of that to find Sweep as soon as we can and bring her back.
In case they come back on their own, we leave a note on the door for them to call the dorm leader, and then we depart on our search.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nope, that won't work. Ooh, and this one's the wrong color!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sweep! There you are!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! Wh-what?! What're you doing in my favorite gathering spot?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Looking all over for you, that's what! At Fuji's request.
choice_data_list: You're about to miss curfew! Come on, let's go back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: For real? I had no idea it was so late!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: B-but, I don't care! I'm not going aaanywhere until I find some medicinal herbs, and that's that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter? Perhaps we can help you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're not the sort of magical girl to simply break rules for no reason, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Urk!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Rrrg… Fine! You're right, I'm not! But my grandma got a fever yesterday…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And it won't come down, no matter what I do. So I wanna try healing her with magic.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see. But if you don't make it back to the dorm before curfew, everyone's going to be worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: They may even end up calling your grandmother. That's certainly not what you want, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: O-of course not!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Then, it sounds like you really should let us assist in your search.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You can give us the most relevant information, and we'll use that to narrow down potential harvesting locations.
choice_data_list: Then we can find those herbs and make it back on time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …O-okay, fine.
And so, thanks to Biwa Hayahide's logic and wisdom, we locate the herbs in no time at all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sweep! I'm so glad you've returned home safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, so, uh… Thanksforyourhelptoday. Byyye!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Goodness me! I don't believe I've ever heard her say the word "thanks." What manner of spell did you cast on her?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No spell. I merely interjected myself into her personal affairs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She reminds me of Brian when she was little. I couldn't resist helping her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, your "interjecting," is always a boon to me, as well as the whole dorm.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Today certainly has been no exception. I give you my thanks, Hayahide.
The slightest blush crawls across Biwa Hayahide's face in response to the unexpected compliment from Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good idea. She'll be the more difficult to track, so considering that two heads are better than one, we should take charge of finding her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's first identify any nearby locations which could reasonably be described as "marvelous."
In case they come back on their own, we leave a note on the door for them to call the dorm leader, and then we depart on our search.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She's not at the stage…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Not at the Three Goddesses statue, either. Could she be inside somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's try to reason this out. What "marvelous" places might we find indoors? The music room, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But with no one there right now, calling it "marvelous" seems a bit inaccu—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: How exquisitely red and marvelous! ☆ So marvelously sparkly! ★

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Marvelous?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Why, if it isn't Hayahide! What brings you here? ☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I could ask you the same.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I heard you were on a "marvelous search," but I still have yet to grasp what, exactly, that entails.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Well, um, I heard a marvelous rumor that if you run around inside the school at night, a red light chases you…

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So I tried it, and it turns out it's true! I've been having so much fun with it! ☆
choice_data_list: That… sounds a lot like a ghost.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Th-the existence of ghosts s-simply isn't supported by any kind of scientific evidence!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But… for argument's sake, if they do exist, how… might one go about dealing with them?
Hellooo? Hellooooo?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's the red light! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Whoa! ☆ You're really moving, Hayahide! ★
choice_data_list: Wait. This red light is no ghost, it's…

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to scare you.

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text: Shouldn't you be heading home so you don't miss curfew?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I believe I owe you both an apology.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I got a little spooked, I will admit, but that doesn't excuse me for running off by myself.
choice_data_list: It's really nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Indeed! All that matters is that our combined efforts have brought Marvelous and Sweep back home safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heh. But I must admit, never in my wildest dreams would I have guessed you were afraid of ghosts! How adorable!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Urk! I-I mean, who isn't scared of ghosts?! Ghosts are scary!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Almost nothing is known about their behavior! What are you supposed to do if you see one?!
choice_data_list: But it was just a security guard, so it's fine!
But it was just a security guard, so it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And thank goodness for that. If it were anything else, I don't think I'd be getting any sleep tonight at all!
And with that, Biwa Hayahide lets out a deep sigh of genuine relief, slightly embarrassed, but ultimately no worse for wear.
